text: Breizh Cola's website is the property of BRASSERIE LANCELOT, a SAS registered in Vannes (RCS B 950 471 177). Le Journal des Entreprises reported in November 2020 that the Norman cooperative Agrial is the new owner of Brasserie Lancelot, which makes Lancelot beers and Breizh Cola; Agrial lists Breizh Cola among the leading products of its Pommes & Boissons branch.
short: Breizh Cola is a Brasserie Lancelot brand within the Agrial cooperative.
